title: Expected Attention: KV Cache Compression by Estimating Attention from Future Queries Distribution
authors: Alessio Devoto; Maximilian Jeblick; Simon Jégou
research_focus: KV cache compression, Long-context / Prefix cache, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: KV cache memory consumption is a major bottleneck for long-context LLM inference, yet attention-score-based pruning is impractical: attention scores from future tokens are unavailable at compression time, and Flash Attention never materializes the full attention matrix, making even past scores inaccessible.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 的記憶體用量是長 context LLM 推理的主要瓶頸；然而基於 attention 分數的剪枝在實務上難以落地：壓縮當下無法取得未來 token 的 attention 分數，且 Flash Attention 不會實體化完整的 attention 矩陣，連過去的分數也無從存取。

key_innovation.en: Expected Attention: a training-free compression method that models future queries as a Gaussian distribution (exploiting the near-Gaussian statistics of LLM hidden states) and computes each KV pair's expected attention score in closed form via the moment-generating function, weighting by the value-vector norm to rank and evict low-impact KV pairs in both prefill and decode. Also releases KVPress, a PyTorch library benchmarking 20+ KV cache compression methods with a public leaderboard.
key_innovation.zh: Expected Attention：一種 training-free 壓縮方法，利用 LLM hidden state 近似 Gaussian 分佈的統計特性，將未來 query 建模為 Gaussian 分佈，並透過 moment-generating function 以閉式解計算每個 KV pair 的期望 attention 分數，再結合 value 向量範數對 KV pair 排序並剔除低影響者，同時適用於 prefill 與 decode。另開源 KVPress：以 PyTorch 實作、收錄 20 餘種 KV cache 壓縮方法並附公開 leaderboard 的基準測試函式庫。

baselines_compared: SnapKV, TOVA, KeyDiff, DuoAttention, KNorm, StreamingLLM, Q-Filters

key_improvements.en: Prunes up to 60% of the KV cache while preserving quality; at 50% compression matches the uncompressed baseline on needle-in-a-haystack while halving KV cache size; saves up to 15 GB peak memory at 120k context on Llama3.1-8B; consistently outperforms baselines across both prefill and decode.
key_improvements.zh: 可剪除最多 60% 的 KV cache 而維持品質；在 50% 壓縮率下於 needle-in-a-haystack 測試與未壓縮基準持平，同時將 KV cache 大小減半；Llama3.1-8B 於 120k context 下峰值記憶體最多節省 15 GB；在 prefill 與 decode 兩種情境均一致優於各基準方法。
